candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Susie Lake is a high alpine lake in the Desolation Wilderness (El Dorado Co.), in the Glen Alpine Creek / Fallen Leaf Lake drainage within the Lake Tahoe basin (Lake Tahoe Basin Management Unit) — but it sits well upstream of the 'first lake', so the special Lake Tahoe tributary closure (§7.50(b)(152), which reaches only flowing tributaries upstream to the first lake, and within 300 ft of their mouths) does not apply to the lake body itself. The lake is not listed by name in §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide lake regulation §5.85(a)(1): open all year, 5/10.

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)

candidates.authorityName: USDA Forest Service — Desolation Wilderness (Eldorado National Forest)
candidates.citation: Eldorado National Forest — Desolation Day Use Permits & Parking

parameters.description: Susie Lake lies inside the Desolation Wilderness (Eldorado National Forest management), where a wilderness permit is required to visit. Day use: a free self-issued permit is required at trailheads during the summer quota season; day use is never subject to a fee or quota. In winter (roughly October–March) no day-use permit is required.

raw.permit: free self-issue at trailhead during summer

candidates.summary: Free Desolation Wilderness day-use permit required (self-issue at trailheads in summer); no day-use fee or quota

candidates.authorityName: USDA Forest Service — Desolation Wilderness (Eldorado National Forest)
candidates.citation: Eldorado National Forest — Desolation Wilderness Permits

parameters.description: Overnight camping in the Desolation Wilderness requires a wilderness permit year-round; a per-day, per-zone quota is in place from the Friday before Memorial Day through September 30 (70% reservable online at recreation.gov, 30% walk-in). Fees apply to overnight permits only.

raw.overnight_fee_verbatim: Overnight Wilderness Permit Fee - $5/person for one night, $10/person for 2 to 14 nights. The cost of a single permit will not exceed $100. Children 12 and under are free.
raw.quota_season: Friday before Memorial Day through September 30
raw.quota_verbatim: A quota in place from the Friday before Memorial Day through September 30 of each year.

candidates.summary: Overnight Desolation Wilderness permit required year-round; quota (Fri before Memorial Day–Sept 30) and per-person fees apply
